definitions.explanation: Working the standard number of hours set by an employer, typically around 40 hours per week. Contrasts with part-time work.

examples.japanese: フルタイム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧フルタイム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to work a full-time job while raising children.

examples.japanese: ⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧フルタイム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えたら→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧、⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}→福利厚生：04882_fukurikousei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I switched from part-time to full-time, both my salary and benefits improved.

notes:
A loanword from English "full-time." Used primarily in the context of employment to describe working standard hours, as opposed to ⟦パートタイム→パートタイム：25267_paatotaimu⟧ (part-time).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フルタイム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work full-time
- フルタイム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: a full-time job
- フルタイム{勤務|きんむ}: full-time employment
- フルタイム⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: full-time employee
- フルタイム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主婦|しゅふ}→主婦：03225_shufu⟧: full-time housewife/homemaker

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{常勤|じょうきん}→常勤：16063_joukin⟧: full-time (employment) — more formal Japanese equivalent used in job postings and contracts
- ⟦パートタイム→パートタイム：25267_paatotaimu⟧: part-time — the antonym, also a loanword
- ⟦{非常勤|ひじょうきん}→非常勤：10675_hijoukin⟧: part-time, non-regular — formal antonym of ⟦{常勤|じょうきん}→常勤：16063_joukin⟧

USAGE:
フルタイム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主婦|しゅふ}→主婦：03225_shufu⟧ ("full-time housewife") is a common expression emphasizing that homemaking is a serious, full-time occupation. In sports contexts, フルタイム can also mean the full duration of a match.
